InstallerSettings.Label: Install scope
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: System installs machine-wide to C:\Program Files\DBeaver via /allusers. User installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\DBeaver via /currentuser and needs no elevation.

InstallerSettings.Label: Disable AI features
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Appends -Dai.disabled=true to dbeaver.ini after install. The installer replaces dbeaver.ini on every install, so the append re-runs each time.
